keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Substrings matched against the domain name, e.g. shop, dental, law, studio, your brand name. At least one keyword or TLD is required.

tlds.title: TLDs (optional)
tlds.description: Only return domains under these TLDs, e.g. com, io, shop. Empty = all TLDs.

daysBack.title: Days of lists to scan
daysBack.description: How many recent daily lists to scan (each day is ~70,000 new domains). Lists are published one day behind.

enrichWithDns.title: Enrich with DNS and website check
enrichWithDns.description: Per matched domain: does it resolve, is email (MX) configured and with which provider, is a website live and what is its title. Domains with no DNS yet are billed as basic rows.

maxDomains.title: Max domains per run
maxDomains.description: Cap on domain rows returned. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip domains seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned domains across runs and skip them. Turn on for a scheduled daily prospect feed.
